story: Nobody tells you perimenopause starts in your late 30s. The hot flashes, the mood swings, the brain fog. Glad I found this community. Would love to hear what worked for others with sleep issues.

title: Getting a diagnosis took two visits
story: I had irregular periods for a year. The first doctor said it was stress. At a second visit, an ultrasound and hormone tests led to a PCOS diagnosis. Writing down my period dates helped the doctor a lot.
tip: Track your period dates before your visit.

title: Tiredness I ignored for months
story: I felt tired for months and thought it was normal. A blood test showed low hemoglobin. My doctor explained the cause and set a follow-up plan. Repeating the test later mattered.
tip: Ask when your test should be repeated.

title: Managing sugar in pregnancy
story: I was told I had gestational diabetes at 26 weeks and I was scared. Diet counselling at my hospital made it easier. I was asked to test again after delivery.
tip: Ask for a diet counselling session.

title: Understanding my TSH report
story: I did not understand my report until my doctor explained what TSH means. Now I keep all reports in one folder and carry them to every visit.

title: Years of painful periods
story: I lived with painful periods for years. What helped was writing down when pain happened and how bad it was, then showing my gynecologist.

title: Night sweats and sleep
story: Night sweats kept waking me up. Talking to my doctor about my options, instead of just putting up with it, made a real difference.
tip: Note your symptoms and how they affect your day.
